findings.issue: NaN result plans omitted signaling-NaN operands, operand orders and the two-NaN cases the MAG variants delegate
findings.resolution: quiet and signaling NaN rows in both orders and two-NaN delegation rows, result class observed with IEEE_CLASS/IEEE_IS_NAN

findings.issue: exception assertions were skipped whenever halting support was absent
findings.resolution: flag rows keyed to IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG; halting is set off where controllable, otherwise read and the row skipped if on (the initial halting mode is processor dependent)

findings.issue: 'No other exceptions are signaled' was not tested
findings.resolution: flags cleared before each row; only IEEE_INVALID signaling for signaling-NaN inputs, all five quiet for numeric rows
